subject.title: fix(compaction): rotate transcript after compaction by default (#112476)

question: Should an unset `truncateAfterCompaction` setting begin rotating persisted successor transcripts for existing sessions, or should the compaction-preparation failure be repaired while preserving the documented opt-in default?
rationale: This is an intentional default change to persisted session behavior, and the supplied evidence does not establish that the existing opt-in policy is the cause of the reported model-context failure.

options.title: Preserve opt-in rotation and find the root cause
options.body: Keep the current default and reproduce the full compaction-preparation failure before landing a targeted fix.

options.title: Approve default-on rotation as a product change
options.body: Adopt the new default only with aligned schema/docs, explicit upgrade and recovery reasoning, and real session proof for both default and opt-out behavior.

recommendation.title: Preserve opt-in rotation and find the root cause
recommendation.body: Keep the current default and reproduce the full compaction-preparation failure before landing a targeted fix.
